**[P2] Do not reuse a future completion as the next local start**

`logicalTimestamp()` returns the invocation-wide high-water mark and is also used for missing start timestamps. If a backend completion is slightly ahead of the process clock, a following virtual context starts at that future time while ordinary user spans still use the local provider clock, placing them before their SDK parent. Keep the high-water mark for fallback ends and invocation cleanup, but derive fallback starts from the current bounded invocation clock; add a future backend end followed by a virtual-context test.
